experiment: controlled V4.1 five-epoch versus eight-epoch retraining on identical expanded synthetic paper-disjoint data
rationale: 8 epochs increased same-benchmark AUROC by 0.012 over 5 but remains below frozen v3. AI recall 23.8%, below 40% target; clean FPR 4.8% versus v3 3.68%; unseen native donor performance decreased versus five epochs; resized recall remained 4/120.
caveats: Synthetic manipulations, not validated real-world forgeries
One held-out OpenAI source generation is not a generator-family-disjoint evaluation
Do not compare directly with earlier 35.4% v3 recall from a different benchmark
v3 remains the installed experimental blot checkpoint; no production change
